items.q: that's the band that Benny Goodman would hire... we had Bill Harris and Flip Phillips, and maybe Gene DiNovi, and we worked here at Basin Street, East.

ctx.x: Sure, and that's the band that Benny Goodman would hire when he would go to Europe, we had Bill Harris and Flip Phillips, and maybe Gene DiNovi, and we worked here at Basin Street, East. We came back here, I don't know
if you remember when we worked there .
